2.69.1 Table.Name
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Table.Name attribute specifies a unique identifier for a Table. This attribute MUST be specified.
The value of the Table.Name attribute MUST be a NormalizedString that is a case-sensitive CLS-
compliant identifier [UTR15]. This value MUST be unique among the set of all report item and scope
names.
Following is the parent element of the Table.Name attribute.
Parent elements
Table
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Table.Name attribute.
 <xsd:attribute name="Name" type="xsd:normalizedString" use="required" />
